stocks.rule: every overlapping-portfolio signal whose search-year book Sharpe before costs is at least 0.3 in absolute value, signed by that Sharpe, in every industry with at least 10 eligible names

book.netting: positions summed per stock across sleeves before costs
book.leverage_updates: at each sleeve's rebalance; book scale at month ends

crypto.rule: cash-and-carry per coin (long Binance spot, short the same coin's perpetual), on while the trailing mean daily funding is above the threshold

combined.weighting: stocks and crypto at equal risk (each scaled to the target volatility on stock days), the sum scaled again to the target volatility
